findings.mechanism: Read-modify-write without SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE leads to lost update under READ COMMITTED (01-isolation-levels).
findings.remediation: Fetch the Shipment with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or replace the read‑modify‑write with a single atomic UPDATE (e.g., UPDATE shipment SET delivery_count = delivery_count + 1, status='delivered' WHERE id=:id) inside a SERIALIZABLE transaction.
findings.arithmetic: Two concurrent calls both read delivery_count=0, each adds 1, both commit. Final delivery_count can be at most 1 (lost one increment).
